stories.title: Define Tool Scope Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a strict schema for tool scope boundaries including allowed tools per context, request metadata requirements, and validation rules to ensure all tool calls can be evaluated against an explicit contract.

stories.title: Implement Server-Side Scope Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic that evaluates each tool call against the defined scope contract and enforces allowlist boundaries, rejecting or sanitizing calls that exceed permitted scope.

stories.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement into Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate the scope enforcement logic directly into the tool_router execution flow so that every tool invocation is validated before dispatch, including handling of Anthropic tool_use blocks and chat history injection.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Scope Enforcement
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating that out-of-scope tool calls are blocked, valid calls pass, and edge cases (malformed input, missing scope metadata) are handled safely.

stories.title: Scope Enforcement Error Handling and Response Contract
stories.description: Define and implement standardized error responses for blocked or invalid tool calls, including user-safe messaging, internal error codes, and consistent formatting for downstream handling in the chat response pipeline.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (chat response handling and tool loop integration)
